0	[Music]	[Música]
1	The Parashah of the week, Parashat Balak. This week
2	falls the yahrzeit of Rabbeinu the Or HaChaim HaKadosh.
3	Not many of the great sages of Israel are called by the name
4	"the Holy."
5	The Or HaChaim HaKadosh
6	was a great kabbalist
7	and, on the other hand, also an immense genius in Torah. He
8	combined Pshat and Kabbalah.
9	Unfortunately, he passed away at the age of 47. Very young,
10	but in his lifetime he managed to write many, many
11	books.
12	The most famous book is the Or HaChaim HaKadosh
13	on the Torah,
14	but he has other books. He has a book called Peri
15	To'ar. Peri To'ar is a great, deep and very powerful book
16	on the laws of forbidden and permitted. Shulchan Arukh,
17	Yoreh De'ah. He has a book, Rishon LeTzion.
18	Rishon LeTzion on part of the tractates of the Shas, immense
19	and wonderful pilpulim.
20	He also has a book, Chefetz HaShem, on the tractates of the Shas,
21	in halachah and in aggadah.
22	Many, many very important books, but
23	the book that all of Israel loves to study is the Or
24	HaChaim HaKadosh. The Or HaChaim is a book that investigates
25	and expounds from the language of the verses, to understand also
26	sublime ideas of Mussar that are in this book, and on the other hand there is
27	in it also a great many halachot, a great deal of pilpul
28	of Torah law, a great and sweet book.
29	I heard from my father, my teacher, Maran Rabbeinu Ovadia Yosef, may the memory of
30	the righteous and holy be a blessing,
31	that any person who suffers from an illness of the eyes
32	should study the Or HaChaim HaKadosh.
33	Reading in the Or HaChaim HaKadosh sanctifies
34	the eyes and also heals them. And Abba told me
35	that when he was sick, suffering from eye pains, he studied
36	the Or HaChaim on the Parashah and he became healthy. This is
37	a segulah. That is to say, the Or HaChaim HaKadosh was entirely
38	holiness, and his books too are full of holiness.
39	By his light we will walk, and his merit will protect us. Amen. May it be so.
